metadata.title: Device Lifecycle

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing device state transitions across provisioning, operation, modification, and decommissioning.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Connected devices, embedded systems, cyber‑physical platforms, and autonomous devices throughout their operational lifespan.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining device lifecycle states and transitions as auditable trust signals.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines lifecycle state as authoritative signal data describing device eligibility, not permission or safety approval.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines baseline lifecycle expectations for devices, including onboarding and disposition.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance for managing device lifecycle, updates, and end‑of‑life conditions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that trust changes over time and must reflect lifecycle state.

metadata.remarks: Device Lifecycle defines the states and transitions a device may undergo from provisioning through decommissioning. This pattern emits lifecycle signals only and does not authorize changes, approve updates, or assert device safety or correctness.

components.title: Device Provisioning State
components.description: Defines the initial onboarding and commissioning state of a device.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Device provisioning and onboarding states are explicitly defined.

components.title: Device Operational State
components.description: Defines the normal operational execution state of a device.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Operational lifecycle state is maintained and observable.

components.title: Device Modification State
components.description: Defines lifecycle transitions involving update, patching, configuration change, or maintenance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Device modification states are distinguishable from normal operation.

components.title: Device Decommissioning State
components.description: Defines end‑of‑life, retirement, or removal from service states.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Device retirement and decommissioning states are explicitly managed.

components.title: Device Lifecycle Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what being in a lifecycle state does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Lifecycle state does not imply authorization, safety assurance, or mission approval.
